basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old software engineer living in Atlanta, Georgia. I've been passionate about programming since my high school days and have a knack for problem-solving. In addition to my professional life, I'm an avid gamer, particularly enjoying strategy and simulation games like Miners Haven. I have a coonhound named Rusty and spend my weekends exploring local trails with him. I'm currently in a long-term relationship. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work and occasionally during my lunch break.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a bachelor's degree in Computer Science from Georgia Tech. My expertise in software development and systems engineering comes from over a decade of professional experience, coupled with personal projects and continuous learning through online courses and tech forums.
